audit.h2: A 132-point AI SEO, AEO, GEO & AIO audit framework
audit.intro: Every project uses the same 132-point checklist in 10 groups. It covers technical SEO, on-page SEO, trust signals, answers, brand facts and AI search.
categories: Technical SEO
HTTPS, sitemaps, indexability, Core Web Vitals infrastructure, llms.txt, AI crawler access
On-Page SEO
Titles, headings, keyword strategy, semantic entities, internal linking
GEO
Entity graphs, SameAs, Wikidata, citation sources, knowledge panel readiness
AEO
Direct answers, FAQPage, HowTo, featured snippets, voice search readiness
E-E-A-T
Author credentials, editorial policy, case studies, transparency signals
AIO
Chunked sections, LLM-friendly formatting, retrieval blocks, AI-ready metadata
UX & Accessibility
WCAG, keyboard navigation, contrast, sticky CTAs, accessible forms
Performance
Core Web Vitals, LCP, INP, CLS, caching, compression
Analytics & Conversion
GA4, GSC, heatmaps, funnels, call and form tracking, CRM integration
AI Discoverability
ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity & Copilot readiness, AI visibility score

items: Why choose Openink Hub as your AEO expert?

As an AEO expert, Openink Hub shapes your pages so Google, voice assistants and AI tools can quote them as the answer. We also connect AEO with SEO, GEO, AIO and automation, and we report which answers you win each month.

An AI chatbot is a virtual helper. It reads customer questions and answers at once, with no person needed.
Can AI chatbots replace human support?
AI chatbots handle common questions and repeat tasks well. People are still needed for hard cases and personal help.
What industries benefit from business automation?
Health care, schools, real estate, retail, factories, finance, hotels, logistics and service firms all gain a lot from automation.
What is Off-Page SEO and how does it improve website rankings?
Off-page SEO is work done outside your own site, such as earning backlinks, reviews and brand mentions. It shows search engines that others trust you, which helps your pages rank higher.
AI studies search trends, finds keyword chances, improves content structure and helps create content that better matches what people search for.
